sloka: पर लोके महाराजो नूनम् द्रक्ष्यति मे पिता ।कथम् प्रतिज्ञाम् संश्रुत्य मया त्वम् अभियोजितः ॥३-६१-७॥
transliteration: para loke mahārājo nūnam drakṣyati me pitā ।katham pratijñām saṁśrutya mayā tvam abhiyojitaḥ ॥3-61-7॥

translations.english: My father say will surely in the other world: Without completing the appointed period of the vow taken, how could you come here ? Fie upon you You are irresponsible. You are ignoble. You are a liar.
